## TRA Timeline

#### SPAC business combination and TRA execution

- 2020-12-10: Merger agreement 8-K attaches the form-of TRA as Exhibit 10.2 (announcement of Silver Spike / WM Holding Company business combination).
- 2021-06-16: Business combination closes; executed TRA dated June 16, 2021 between WM Technology, Inc. (Corporate Taxpayer) and the continuing WMH LLC members (TRA Parties); Ghost Media Group, LLC named TRA Party Representative; 85% of Cumulative Net Realized Tax Benefit.

#### Economic extinguishment via valuation allowance

- 2021-12-31: First 10-K recognizes a $34.2M TRA liability against a $34.2M deferred tax asset.
- 2022-12-31: Full valuation allowance on TRA-related deferred tax assets; TRA liability written off, $142.4M income from "change in tax receivable agreement liability"; residual $0.5M.

## Explanation

WM Technology's TRA was executed on June 16, 2021 at the closing of the Silver Spike SPAC business combination with WM Holding Company, LLC (Weedmaps). The contract is a standard Up-C structure: WM Technology pays the continuing WMH LLC members 85% of the Cumulative Net Realized Tax Benefit from Section 754 basis step-ups generated by the initial cash exchange of LLC units and any future exchanges under the Exchange Agreement. The TRA functioned for one year before WM Technology recognized a full valuation allowance against the TRA-related deferred tax assets in Q4 2022, writing off essentially the entire liability and recording $142.4M of income from remeasurement. The TRA remains legally in force and could reinstate if WMH LLC's taxable income makes the underlying tax attributes realizable (residual disclosed amounts have crept up to $4.4M by FY2024); no payments have ever been made. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
